VI. 3. 3</ls>. .²2 The sky. .²3 The fourth sign of the zodiac. .²4 Mystical name of the letter व्. .²5 A God. .²6 A man. .²7 The world of the Manes. .²8 A Rākṣasa or Asura. .²9 (In <ab>Phil.</ab>) तुष्टि or acquiescence of the soul. .²10 Power; splendour; fruitfulness. --({%dual%}) अम्भसी Heaven and earth. --(<ab>pl.</ab>) Collective name for Gods, men, Manes, and demons.
